name: Armstrong Redwoods SNR
description: Armstrong Redwoods State Natural Reserve near Guerneville protects a grove of old-growth coast redwoods, including the 310-foot Parson Jones Tree and the 1,400-year-old Colonel Armstrong Tree.
fullDescription: Armstrong Redwoods State Natural Reserve near Guerneville protects a grove of old-growth coast redwoods, including the 310-foot Parson Jones Tree and the 1,400-year-old Colonel Armstrong Tree.
whatTheyOffer:
- Easy walks among old-growth redwoods on self-guided nature trails
- Visitor center and picnic areas
- Group picnic area (Smokey's Den) available by reservation
- No camping in the reserve (camping at neighboring Austin Creek SRA is currently closed)
- Dogs allowed only on the paved road and in developed picnic areas, on leash
- Open 8 am to one hour after sunset; phone (707) 869-2015
howToGetIt:
**Fees:**
- Day use: $10 per vehicle ($9 with a senior 62+)

**Save with park passes:** Armstrong Redwoods accepts the California Explorer and Golden Poppy annual passes, the Free Fourth Grade Pass, and the California State Library Parks Pass (free to check out at public libraries).
